source: Student Guide · 204-221 Principles of Medical Sciences 2 · Faculty of Medicine, Siam University · Academic Year 2025 · 4(3-2-7)
method: Transcribed by hand from the student guide PDF (57 pages). The lesson-plan section (printed pages 10-54) gives one page per class with its Lesson Learning Outcomes, Key concepts and Learning resources; every field below is copied from those pages, not inferred. Immunology sessions are listed for completeness but belong to the immuno chapter, not micro.
caveat: This is the course the Microbiology chapter is scoped to. It fixes both the depth (general knowledge, moderately deep) and the organism list. It does NOT cover the per-system infection classes taught inside the organ-system courses (see lesson-plans.json) - those feed the organ chapters and the Microbiology 'Systems' sub.

assessment.summative: MCQ; laboratory sessions use spot diagnosis, spot test and essay
